title: Analista de sistemas sênior
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

Estamos procurando um Analista de Sistemas com grande capacidade de comunicação e espírito investigativo para se juntar à nossa equipe de TI. Este profissional dará suporte e implementará aplicativos de laboratório, ferramentas de controle estatístico, integrações e serviços em nuvem. O candidato ideal deve ser hábil em conduzir sessões de descoberta com equipes de negócios, analisar problemas de ponta a ponta e traduzir as necessidades de negócios em soluções práticas e técnicas.

Responsabilidades:

• Liderar atividades de descoberta para compreender processos de negócios, necessidades dos usuários e requisitos do sistema.

• Realizar investigações aprofundadas e análises de causa raiz para questões técnicas e funcionais.

• Atuar como ponte de comunicação fundamental entre equipes de negócios, usuários finais e TI.

• Implementar, configurar e dar suporte a aplicativos de laboratório (LIMS, automação de software de integração, ferramentas de QC/QA, plataformas de revisão de dados).

• Dar suporte a ferramentas de controle estatístico e qualidade analítica (monitoramento de dados, painéis de qualidade).

• Configurar e manter serviços do Azure, incluindo App Services, Storage, SQL e API Management (APIM).

• Compreender arquiteturas de servidor e realizar configurações no nível do aplicativo.

• Documentar processos, requisitos e decisões técnicas de maneira clara e estruturada.

• Colaborar com equipes globais de TI e fornecedores externos em melhorias e integrações de sistemas.

• Participar de testes de aceitação do usuário, validação e sessões de treinamento.


O que você precisa ter

• Graduação em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área relacionada.

• Certificações em Azure ou experiência equivalente são um diferencial.

• Experiência prévia em ambientes de laboratório, qualidade ou manufatura é uma vantagem.


Habilidades Técnicas

• Experiência com aplicativos de laboratório e sistemas de CQ/CQ.

• Conhecimento de estatística ou controle estatístico de processos (CEP).

• Experiência com serviços do Azure (App Services, Storage, APIM, SQL).

• Sólida compreensão de APIs, integrações e fluxos de dados.

• Familiaridade com ambientes de servidor e conceitos básicos de redes.

• Conhecimento de SQL (consultas, solução de problemas, compreensão de esquemas).

Habilidades interpessoais

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação (verbal e escrita).

• Forte mentalidade investigativa e analítica.

• Capacidade de traduzir detalhes técnicos em linguagem acessível aos negócios.

• À vontade para conduzir workshops, sessões de requisitos e entrevistas com usuários.

• Fortes habilidades organizacionais e de multitarefa.


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. A posição é oferecida em regime 100% Home Office , com atuação para um time global e ambiente ágil.

What We Offer

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Gestão de Ativos

Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.


O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.

  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
  • Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).

description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.


Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.


You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.


You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.js.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios.
  • Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services.
  • Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred).
  • Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.g., SSRF).
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact.
  • Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the Node.js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase.
  • Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations.
  • Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness.
  • Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment.
  • Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments.
  • Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes.
  • Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms.
  • Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes.
  • Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability.
  • Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes.
  • Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development.
  • Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

  • Participar ativamente em análises pós-incidente para identificar causas raízes e implementar medidas preventivas.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior (Governança e GRC)
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente. Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

Principais Responsabilidades:


Governança e Compliance

  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos de Segurança da Informação.

  • Atuar na sustentação de certificações e avaliações regulatórias.

Gestão de Riscos e Controles

  • Conduzir análises de riscos de segurança (técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios).
  • Definir, implementar e monitorar controles internos de segurança.
  • Avaliar riscos de terceiros e fornecedores críticos.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento de riscos e acompanhar sua execução.
  • Manter matriz de riscos atualizada e integrada à estratégia corporativa.


Regulamentações e Normas

  • Atuar nos temas relacionados a PCI DSS.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos regulatórios (LGPD, normas contratuais).
  • Traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos e processuais aplicáveis.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na interpretação de requisitos de segurança.


Integração com Áreas Internas

  • Trabalhar em parceria com Jurídico, Compliance, Auditoria, Tecnologia, Privacidade e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar comitês de risco e segurança.
  • Contribuir com indicadores, dashboards executivos e relatórios estratégicos.


Perfil Esperado

  • Visão estratégica de segurança alinhada ao negócio.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de priorização baseada em risco.
  • Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e elevar maturidade organizacional.
  • Mentalidade colaborativa e orientada a governança preventiva.


Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC).
  • Vivência com ISO 27001/27002 e/ou NIST.
  • Experiência em auditorias e avaliação de controles.

Diferenciais:

Indicadores de Sucesso

Contexto de Atuação

A posição integra o White Team, com foco em governança, prevenção, controles e maturidade do programa de Segurança da Informação, atuando de forma estratégica e transversal com múltiplas áreas de negócio.

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:

Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: Product Designer
description:
SigmaMD aims to make a meaningful contribution to the world by changing the way people manage their health. Our growing engineering and product team has deep expertise in consumer tech. We are combining our diverse backgrounds to innovate in Digital Health.


Our goal is to make millions of lives healthier by using technology. We strive to empower patients to take control of their health care and help clinicians better treat them. To achieve this vision we need an outstanding and passionate Product Designer to take on the following responsibilities:


  • Contribute to high-level product thinking while also developing interaction flows, mockups, and prototypes. 
  • Collaborate in a cross-functional team to understand user needs and business goals, and translate them into intuitive and effective product designs.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to communicate design concepts and gather feedback.
  • Advocate for the needs and preferences of both doctors and patients by conducting user research and gathering feedback from both groups, and incorporating their insights into the design process to ensure the product meets the needs of all stakeholders.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, design best practices, and the latest design tools and technologies to ensure the team is delivering high-quality, cutting-edge products.


This person should share our core values of teamwork, empathy, and innovation. Ideally, they have the following:


  • Know how to define a repeatable and shareable design process that encourages collaboration between design, product, and engineering teams.
  • Ask questions that build or help to clarify the problem statement and ensure that you maintain user focus and empathy.
  • Explore and refine concepts, then narrow to the best solution, weighing technical feasibility and scope with your team.
  • Create and maintain UX and UI deliverables including information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, style guides, micro interaction specifications, and pattern libraries.
  • Influence the product vision leading and participating in research, focused on both the intangibles (emotional needs) and tangibles (functional needs)..
  • Champion usability testing within your product team, capture the team's assumptions, identify the correct test methodology to use, document results, communicate actionable feedback and findings back to the team.
  • Communicate your design rationale to project stakeholders and use data to defend your design choices.


Required Skills

  • 2+ years of product design experience (including equivalent UI and UX focused role).
  • Able to provide samples of work that show creative solutions to complex products, strong visual design, and information architecture.
  • A strong understanding of the entire product development process, from research and problem solving through to detailed UI and visual design.
  • Experience with Figma.
  • Understand how modern technologies are used with design.
  • Believe that product and design decisions are inextricably linked.
  • Enjoy shipping small, quick experiments to explore and validate your ideas.
  • Know how to balance the user experience with technical and business requirements.
  • Able to communicate effectively with all stakeholders. Speak KPIs, OKRs and understand how to rely on data to support your work.
  • Not afraid to learn new things to take on a problem.
  • Are a self-starter who works proactively to solve problems and bring clarity to ambiguity
  • Facilitate both design-focused and cross-functional sessions with ease, relying on your knowledge of facilitation tools and techniques


Desired Skills

  • Have an understanding of front end technologies such as HTML and CSS.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Prior experience in a design related role at a startup.
  • Experience with digital health or relatable areas.
  • Experience working with mobile apps.

title: Sales Manager
description:
About the Job

What if every conversation you have, every partnership you build, could accelerate the progress of life science research and precision medicine?

At GeneMind, we are dedicated to making life readable and health actionable through independent innovation in high-throughput gene sequencing technology. We break global technological barriers, deliver accessible and reliable genomic tools to laboratories, hospitals, and research institutions worldwide, and empower scientists and clinicians to turn data into discovery—and discovery into real-world impact.

Working at GeneMind means joining a mission-driven team that combines cutting-edge R&D, industrial execution, and global growth. You will not only sell products but also shape the future of the genomics industry. Supported by passionate innovators, strong technical platforms, and a fast-growing global market, you will grow faster, achieve more, and build a meaningful career in one of the most promising fields of our time.


Position Summary

Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, the Sales Specialist / Sales Manager will be the key commercial driver for GeneMind in assigned territories. You will build channel ecosystems, develop key accounts and KOL networks, drive market expansion, and deliver sustainable sales growth. This is a customer-centric, technical, and strategic sales role that combines channel management, key customer development, market insight, and cross-team collaboration—not just order execution. You will directly contribute to GeneMind’s global expansion and market leadership in next-generation sequencing (NGS).


Key Measures Of Success

  • Achievement of quarterly and annual sales targets, revenue, and order intake
  • Healthy channel partner development, activation, and retention
  • Successful development of key accounts and KOL relationship building
  • Accurate market intelligence collection and competitive strategy support
  • High customer satisfaction and long-term partnership loyalty
  • Effective product training and capability improvement for channel partners


Position Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage channel partners in assigned regions, expand market coverage, and build a stable, high-quality distribution system.
  • Identify and develop key customers and KOLs; establish long-term, trusted professional relationships.
  • Collect and analyze market dynamics, competitor activities, pricing, and customer needs to support regional sales strategies.
  • Deliver professional product presentations and online/offline training to channel partners to improve their sales and technical capabilities.
  • Support partners to close deals, including joint customer visits, demand analysis, solution design, and project follow-up.
  • Develop and execute quarterly and annual regional sales plans, ensure target delivery, and maintain healthy sales funnel management.
  • Collaborate with internal teams including technical support, marketing, and customer service to ensure smooth project delivery and excellent customer experience.
  • Represent GeneMind in academic and industry activities to enhance brand influence and market penetration.

The above responsibilities are representative but not exhaustive; duties may be adjusted to meet business needs.


Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Medicine, Molecular Biology, Biomedical Engineering, or related fields ; Master’s degree is a strong plus.
  • Minimum 3 years of working experience in the NGS / sequencing industry .
  • Demonstrated experience in sales, channel development, or key account management in life science instruments, IVD, or sequencing-related fields.
  • Experience selling sequencing instruments or related laboratory equipment is highly preferred.
  • Professional, self-motivated, and target-oriented with strong learning and communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to build trust with partners, KOLs, and research clients.
  • Ability and willingness to travel frequently as needed.
  • High integrity, customer-first mindset, and alignment with GeneMind’s mission and values.


Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets in the life science or IVD industry.
  • Existing channel resources, customer network, or KOL connections in regional markets.
  • Experience in technical sales or solution-based sales (not just transactional).
  • Strong presentation, training, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Familiarity with NGS workflows, clinical diagnostics, or life science research scenarios.
  • Global market exposure or cross-cultural communication experience is a plus.


Who We Are

GeneMind is a leading global innovator and manufacturer of gene sequencing systems with independent core intellectual property. We develop and produce high-performance sequencing platforms to support scientific research and precision medicine across the globe. We embrace diversity, encourage growth, and empower every team member to create real impact.

We are an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager in our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget . This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.g., Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning & Execution: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities.
  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site and remote/hybrid work environments .
  • Budget & Risk Management: Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively; implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Delivery: Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.g., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs.
  • Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement: Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emerging industry trends (like AI integration in project management , DevSecOps , and new collaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Professional Knowledge: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding of IT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentals to effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects using project management methodologies (Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes.
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams , managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such as cloud computing projects, digital transformation , or AI-driven solutions is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment , managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background in network/security infrastructure projects or software development projects is advantageous.
  • Methodologies: Certifications or hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) or DevOps/DevSecOps practices.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles , with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure . Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) , Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) , or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months

title: Market Intelligence Manager - Americas
description:
Summary of Job Duties


Ensure their regional team fulfils the roles and responsibilities of:

Customer development

  • Lead opportunity assessment: proactively engage in customer development, leverage marketing intelligence capability to assess customer opportunity, generate customer leads from current or potential opportunities driving from new developed product and formulation.
  • Customer development action plan: proactively engage in action plan formulation, and engage in customer communication and execution
  • Customer solution proposal: coordinate external resources to design customized market service plan based on customer’s need

Customer relationship management

  • Proactively engage in relationship mgmt. with KA’s marketing related departments, gathering market insights to support R&D and BD

Marketing service:

  • Delivery & after-sales: responsible for leveraging internal capability and external resources to deliver marketing service and after-sales


Main Responsibilities


Although the position is a management role the candidate also expected to be hands on and involved wherever required for the regional team to carry out the following responsibilities:


  • Market Research

To visit customer site with sales and also collect market information in their region such as:

  • Customer Survey Analysis
  • Customer service needs/opportunities
  • Customer’s org chart
  • Customer’s end consumer insights and trends
  • Prospects and opportunity analysis
  • Category Analysis
  • Sales Channels
  • Competitive landscape


  • Marketing Support Service

Help promote, drive and expand our added value service to our customers to provide them with our 360 marketing solution

  • Market Research/Business Intelligence
  • Receipe support
  • `zSales distribution


  • Account Based Marketing

Will be responsible to perform research to find high-value accounts to target as well as spend time developing growth strategies from their findings. They will ensure marketing activities line up with strategies developed and ultimately translate plans to the sales team for execution. They need to ensure the follow steps are covered:

  • Identify high-value target accounts – Identify key accounts that have the potential to contribute the most to the revenue of your company.
  • Conduct research on those accounts - Get a good snapshot of customer needs and pain points, as well as where they are in their customer journey.
  • Develop customized marketing campaigns - Using information you learned in the research phase to inform your strategy, develop creative assets that will resonate with the target account.
  • Run customized marketing campaigns - Launch your campaigns to the target account.
  • Measure customized marketing campaigns - Analyze the data to see how your campaigns are performing.


  • Online Marketing

Will be in charge of creating localized content regularly update the following marketing channels in their assigned region.

  • Webinars
  • SEO – Quarterly updates on the regional assigned webpage
  • Social media – Weekly updates on social media platforms in where they are based – language will depend on where they are based
  • Email marketing – Monthly articles that can be distributed for sales use in their regions.


  • Offline Marketing

Will handle the planning and implementation of offline marketing tasks in the assigned region which could cover

  • Exhibitions
  • Roadshows
  • Print (Quarterly updates)
  • PowerPoint presentations (Company introductions, products or service introductions)


  • Public Relations
  • Build up media relations and ‘Distribution Media List’ for future press release distribution in their assigned region.
  • Ensure appearance on at least one reputable news website in their assigned region.


Qualifications (Education/Knowledge/Working Experience)


  • Master’s degree in a Marketing related discipline.
  • Around 10 years of experience
  • Knowledgable in hands on B2B2C marketing as well as the consumer market in the beverage industry.


Skills Needed


Market Research and Analysis: The ability to conduct thorough market research, analyze data, and draw actionable insights is crucial for understanding the target market, consumer behavior, and industry trends.

Strategic Planning: Regional Marketing Managers must be adept at developing and executing marketing strategies that align with overall business objectives. This includes setting clear goals, defining KPIs, and creating actionable plans.

Team Leadership and Management: Effective leadership skills are important for managing and motivating a team of marketing professionals. This includes providing guidance, setting expectations, and facilitating collaboration.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Regional Marketing Managers need to work closely with various departments like sales, product development, and supply chain to ensure that marketing initiatives are aligned with overall business operations.

Brand Management: They should have the ability to maintain and enhance the brand image in the specified region. This involves ensuring consistency in messaging, visual identity, and customer experience.

Campaign Management: This skill involves planning, executing, and optimizing marketing campaigns. It requires the ability to set clear objectives, target the right audience, and measure the effectiveness of campaigns.

Budget Management: Effective allocation and management of marketing budgets are essential for maximizing return on investment (ROI) and ensuring that resources are used efficiently.

Data Analysis and Interpretation: Proficiency in using data analytics tools to measure campaign performance, track key metrics, and derive actionable insights is crucial for making informed marketing decisions.

Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills are necessary for conveying marketing messages effectively to various stakeholders, including team members, executives, and external partners.

Adaptability and Flexibility: The ability to adapt to changing market conditions, consumer preferences, and industry trends is vital for staying competitive and achieving long-term success.

Problem-Solving Skills: Regional Marketing Managers should be able to identify challenges and develop creative solutions to overcome them. This includes being resourceful and thinking critically.

Cultural Awareness and Sensitivity: Especially in a regional role, understanding and respecting cultural nuances and preferences is important for tailoring marketing strategies to specific markets.

Time Management: Effectively prioritizing tasks and managing time to meet deadlines is essential in a fast-paced marketing environment.

Tech-Savviness: Familiarity with marketing technology tools and platforms, as well as proficiency in relevant software and applications, is important for executing marketing initiatives efficiently.

Negotiation Skills: The ability to negotiate and build partnerships with external stakeholders, such as agencies, vendors, and media outlets, can be crucial for successful marketing campaigns.

title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)

Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


Role Overview

As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.


What You'll Do

• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

• Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

• Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

What We're Looking For


Must-Have Experience

• 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

• Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

• Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

• Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

• Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

• Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined


Nice to Have

• Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users

• Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals

• Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products

• Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up


How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.


We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.


What You'll Get

• Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

• Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

• Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

• A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work
